اقتبلوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَبَلُوا (iqtabalū) /iq.ta.ba.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# اُقْتُبِلُوا (uqtubilū) /uq.tu.bi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# اِقْتَبِلُوا (iqtabilū) /iq.ta.bi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
